help_stdout:
usage: kaggle kernels files [-h] [-v | --format OUTPUT_FORMAT]
                            [--page-token PAGE_TOKEN] [--page-size PAGE_SIZE]
                            [kernel]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  kernel                Kernel URL suffix in format <owner>/<kernel-name> or <owner>/<kernel-name>/<version> (use "kaggle kernels list" to show options)
  -v, --csv             Print results in CSV format (if not set print in table format)
  --format OUTPUT_FORMAT
                        Print results in selected format (csv, table, json). For details on advanced options, see
                        https://github.com/Kaggle/kaggle-cli/blob/main/docs/output_format.md
  --page-token PAGE_TOKEN
                        Page token for results paging.
  --page-size PAGE_SIZE
                        Number of items to show on a page. Default size is 20, max is 200

source_observed_contract.api_request: kernels_list_files creates ApiListKernelFilesRequest with kernel_slug/user_name and _set_paging(page_size,page_token)
source_observed_contract.version_scope: parse_kernel_string accepts an optional /version, but kernels_list_files does not place version_number in the request; endpoint lists current files for kernel slug
source_observed_contract.pagination_stdout: when nextPageToken is present, CLI writes `Next Page Token = <token>` before printing the page JSON
source_observed_contract.kernels_output_log_side_effect: kernels output writes <kernel-slug>.log from response.log into the output directory
source_observed_contract.kernels_output_download_mapping: kernels output writes each API file item.file_name under the specified destination directory before writing the response-log sidecar
